title: wearOS 2 complications issue
symptom: When using the xDrip complication on a different watchface (not the xDrip watchface), the complication displays 'null null ()'. The xDrip watchface works properly. The issue occurs when the phone is the collector, but works when the watch is the collector.
evidence_quote: If using complications on a different watch face - if the watch is the collector - then the complication works fine. If the phone is used as the collector then the complication displays null null.
